Saying "There, there, good boy/girl" while gently patting Trainer on the head.
---
★ Request
Fade to Black

★ Request
Fade in from Black
---
★ Request
*Visualized image after wiping Trainer's sweat
and putting the handkerchief away.

Is that so...?
Come, let's go have lunch soon.

All right... there. All fresh and clean♪
Make sure to check for your handkerchief and tissues before heading out, okay?

Now, now, take it off.
It's all right~, it'll only take a moment.

Now then, what should we do... hmm...
Ah, I just thought of something.

I reached into my pocket to pull out a handkerchief... but
there was nothing inside. It seems I forgot to bring one...

At first, no one can do everything on their own.
Everyone needs help from those around them.

Yes! It's all thanks to your guidance, Trainer!
I'm counting on you from now on too!

Helping someone fulfill their wish to "be faster than anyone else,"
and making that reality—there is no greater wish than that.
Fufu, it's all right. Leave it to me...

On the contrary, I hear she would help her parents
comfort other crying children of the same age.

So you really don't need to worry about it.
If anything, please let me pamper you more and more♪
...A Trainer ought to be someone their Umamusume can rely on.

Why, you ask...? Hmm, when you ask me like that,
it's a little hard to explain, but...

If I could help with that, wouldn't that be...
a truly, wonderfully lovely thing?

Let's see~... I want you to eat plenty of food
with good nutritional balance, Trainer.

Her attentiveness is one of her greatest virtues. But as a Trainer,
I can't let myself be pampered forever. Because—

Aside from her immense talent, her other most
well-known trait is—

Helping someone grow... In a way, that shared
a lot with how I felt toward Umamusume as a Trainer.

Ever since I noticed it coming loose earlier,
I just couldn't take my mind off it.

Second place, huh... That was close. But your time is definitely improving.
Let's keep this momentum going!

It seemed the day I could finally graduate from Super Creek's pampering
was still a long way off...

There now, hold still.
Good boy/girl, good boy/girl♪
In the end, I ended up getting pampered again...

Be it parents, teachers, or friends...
People grow little by little with help from others.

You feel the same way, Trainer...
Fufu, that makes me quite happy.
I see, so that's why you wanted me to ask a favor of you.

Even when I was little at the daycare center my parents ran,
people always said, "She's such an easy child to raise."

Watching the children who came to our daycare...
Watching them grow, there's something I realized.

Trainer, I took first place~.
Even though it was just a practice race, I'm so happy♪

No, this is a favor from me.
Come on now♪

Trainer, would you please...
let me sew that button back onto your shirt?
Did you say something?

Hmm, I wonder.
Even looking back at my childhood, nothing really comes to mind.

*Phew*, it sure is hot today, isn't it~? ...Oh my?
Trainer, you're sweating so much. Here, let me wipe it for you.

Super Creek is an Umamusume widely known both inside
and outside the Academy for her "exceptional" ability.

...Taking care of people like this and seeing them smile
and cheer up brings me more joy than anything else.

Even during lunch, Super Creek continued to pamper me nonstop.
However, in order to change our dynamic—
